prompts.buildings: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production sprite atlas for CleanCity, a polished mobile cartoon recycling exploration game. Generate ONE image 1536x1024 pixels, exact 3 columns by 2 rows grid of SIX separate isolated neighborhood building clusters. Each cluster contained inside its own 512x512 cell with generous 40px transparent gutter, centered, bottom base near row bottom minus 40px. No overlap between cells, no borders, no text, no backgrounds, true transparent alpha. Consistent elevated 3/4 orthographic camera showing roofs and front/right facades, bold friendly dark outlines, clean colorful cartoon forms, soft detailed painting, casual premium mobile game. NO people, NO roads, no cars. Each cluster is a small island of TWO or THREE buildings tightly arranged on a modest rectangular foundation, sparse tiny greenery. Top-left: leafy colorful neighborhood cottages with brick chimneys and teal shutters. Top-middle: sunny Italian coastal old town, peach/yellow stucco, terracotta roofs, striped cafe awnings, flowers. Top-right: Tunis avenue-inspired French colonial white facades, blue shutters, graceful arches and palm greenery, no actual logos. Bottom-left: Paris cream Haussmann row houses, slate mansard roofs, flowers and small cafe. Bottom-middle: Kyoto traditional warm wood machiya with tiled roofs, glowing paper lanterns, cherry blossom detail. Bottom-right: whimsical spooky purple Victorian houses with crooked roofs, warm amber windows, bare trees, pumpkin details; charming, not horror. Exactly six clusters in six equal cells. Entire surroundings transparent.
